description: Defines the DataURL class for parsing and building 'data' URLs according to RFC 2397, including methods for parsing URL components and generating response headers.

classes.name: DataURL
classes.description: Provides static methods to parse 'data' URLs into components and to build response headers.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a 'data' URL into mime type, charset, and data components, returning true on success.

methods.name: BuildResponse
methods.description: Generates response headers for a 'data' URL, optionally modifying for HEAD requests, returning net::OK on success.
